rationale: The agent did look up the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip and get_user_details), but then performed multiple order-changing writes without documented user confirmation: cancel_pending_order on #W9373487 and #W5481803, and return_delivered_order_items on #W7449508. Policy requires confirming every order-changing action before executing. There is also no clear evidence the agent provided the requested tracking number for the tablet or addressed the lost-tablet refund/reorder request (or handed off to a human if it could not be handled). Additionally, the agent executed several actions at once despite the user’s stated preference to do one thing at a time. Given these issues—unconfirmed writes and incomplete handling of the core request—the interaction fails the pass bar.
